title: 钅 metal (金字旁)
intro: 钅 is the simplified left-side form of 金 (gold, metal). It has five strokes, and the last one is a short rising stroke. Characters with 钅 are metals, metal objects like keys, pots and needles, and money.

ex.zh: 我的钱包和钥匙都不见了。
ex.p: wǒ de qián bāo hé yào shi dōu bù jiàn le
ex.en: My wallet and keys are both gone.

ex.p: zhè gè duō shǎo qián
ex.en: How much is this?

ex.p: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ qián
ex.en: I'm going to the bank to withdraw money.

ex.p: yín háng jǐ diǎn guān mén
ex.en: What time does the bank close?

ex.p: tā dài zhe yī tiáo yín xiàng liàn
ex.en: She's wearing a silver necklace.

ex.p: wǒ qù yín háng qǔ qián
ex.en: I'm going to the bank to withdraw money.

ex.zh: 你写得不错，可是有一个小错误。
ex.p: nǐ xiě de bù cuò kě shì yǒu yī gè xiǎo cuò wù
ex.en: You wrote it well, but there's one small mistake.

ex.p: nǐ shuō de bù cuò
ex.en: What you said is quite right.

ex.p: duì bù qǐ shì wǒ cuò le
ex.en: Sorry, I was wrong.

ex.zh: 坐地铁去机场要四十分钟。
ex.p: zuò dì tiě qù jī chǎng yào sì shí fēn zhōng
ex.en: It takes forty minutes to the airport by subway.

ex.p: běi jīng de dì tiě hěn fāng biàn
ex.en: Beijing's subway is very convenient.

ex.zh: 坐地铁去机场要四十分钟。
ex.p: zuò dì tiě qù jī chǎng yào sì shí fēn zhōng
ex.en: It takes forty minutes to the airport by subway.

ex.p: děng wǔ fēn zhōng
ex.en: Wait five minutes.

ex.p: yī shēng shuō yào dǎ zhēn
ex.en: The doctor says I need an injection.

ex.zh: 我每天早上锻炼一个小时。
ex.p: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang duàn liàn yī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: I work out for an hour every morning.

ex.p: duō duàn liàn shēn tǐ shǎo shēng bìng
ex.en: Work out more, get sick less.

ex.p: tā dài zhe yī tiáo yín xiàng liàn
ex.en: She's wearing a silver necklace.

ex.p: tā jìn shì suǒ yǐ yào dài yǎn jìng
ex.en: He's nearsighted, so he wears glasses.

ex.p: jìng zi zài nǎr
ex.en: Where is the mirror?

ex.p: dōng tiān chī huǒ guō zuì shū fu le
ex.en: Hot pot is the best thing to eat in winter.

ex.p: nǐ chī guò sì chuān huǒ guō ma
ex.en: Have you ever had Sichuan hot pot?

ex.p: wǒ xū yào yī zhī qiān bǐ
ex.en: I need a pencil.

ex.zh: 我的钱包和钥匙都不见了。
ex.p: wǒ de qián bāo hé yào shi dōu bù jiàn le
ex.en: My wallet and keys are both gone.

ex.p: wǒ de yào shi diū le
ex.en: I lost my keys.

texts.title: 读一读 · 钅 metal (金字旁)

lines.zh: 早上我去锻炼，回家的时候发现钥匙不见了。
lines.p: zǎo shang wǒ qù duàn liàn huí jiā de shí hou fā xiàn yào shi bù jiàn le

lines.zh: 我在路上找了二十分钟，没找到。
lines.p: wǒ zài lù shang zhǎo le èr shí fēn zhōng méi zhǎo dào

lines.zh: 后来我去银行取钱，又发现钱包也不在了。
lines.p: hòu lái wǒ qù yín háng qǔ qián yòu fā xiàn qián bāo yě bù zài le

lines.zh: 最后，我在家门口的地上找到了钥匙和钱包。
lines.p: zuì hòu wǒ zài jiā mén kǒu de dì shang zhǎo dào le yào shi hé qián bāo

lines.zh: 晚上我和朋友去吃火锅，心情好多了。
lines.p: wǎn shang wǒ hé péng you qù chī huǒ guō xīn qíng hǎo duō le

qs.q: 钥匙和钱包在哪儿找到的？

exercises.why: 很 has 彳; silver has 钅
失 is only the right part
中 is only the sound part
竟 is only the sound part
